name: Niagara Falls
tagline: The thundering falls on the Canada-US border
summary: Niagara Falls is three waterfalls on the Canada-US border, with the Horseshoe Falls the most powerful in North America. Ride a boat into the mist, walk behind the falls and tour wineries of Niagara-on-the-Lake.
seasonNote: Summer is busiest and the boats run; winter freezes the spray into ice.
arrival: About 1.5 hours from Toronto by car, train or bus.
cashTip: Cards and tap work almost everywhere; cash is rarely needed. Tip 15-20% in restaurants.
